messages:
elaine (partnerships): Quick sync — we need final signoff for the cloud marketplace listing and joint GTM assets. Goal: public launch Tue 2026-04-14. Top items: press embargo, landing page, partner logos, demo account, marketplace listing QA, & announcement blog. Who owns which?

tom (marketing): I can own press + blog. Need embargo window and final quote from CTO. Also want a short customer quote (1-2 lines) if sales can pull someone.

anna (sales): I can chase a customer quote — have two candidates. Will ping them today. Also need co-marketing logo placement and a partner brief to share.

jia (product): Landing page copy + demo script I can draft. Need feature bullets and any screenshots by EOD Fri. Also confirm whether demo account should be read-only or has live inference.

sandeep (eng): For marketplace QA we'll do integration tests against the marketplace API and our dedicated runtime. Quick checklist I suggest:
- image packaging verified
- billing metadata correct
- region/zone availability tested
- health check endpoints returning 200
- demo credentials locked to read-only

I'll run the validator script and share results. Example check:```bash
redwoodctl marketplace validate --listing-id rl-2026-04 --region us-west1
```
Will post logs to the drive.

press-bot: Embargo registered: 2026-04-14 09:00 UTC. Please attach final press release doc and approved quote before 2026-04-10 17:00 UTC. Reminder will be sent 48h prior.

elaine (partnerships): Legal needs logo use + partner co-announcement signoff. @legal-bot — what's timeline? :eyes:

legal-bot: Logo & trademark checklist: partner must provide high-res SVG + written permission. Co-announcement T&Cs need to be signed — typical turn is 3 business days after we send draft. Suggest we send draft by Mon 2026-04-06 to stay on schedule.

anna (sales): I'll request SVGs and permissions from partner today. ETA Wed for assets.

tom (marketing): For the blog: draft outline — 1) problem statement, 2) solution + how Redwood integrates with partner marketplace, 3) customer story, 4) CTA to try in marketplace. I'll drop a doc in marketing folder. Need technical bullets from @jia and a short quote from @sandeep (one line on performance).

jia (product): Technical bullets: native routing to dedicated instances, prefix caching supported, single-click deploy from marketplace listing. Screenshot: deployment flow + console trace. Will deliver by Fri.

sandeep (eng): Quick one-line quote: "Redwood Inference running via the marketplace gives deterministic latency and predictable unit-costs for production traffic." Happy to tweak.

elaine (partnerships): Can someone own the landing page QA (links, analytics, tracking pixels, UTM tags)? Also confirm analytics event names we want. @tom?

tom (marketing): I'll own analytics + UTM. Proposed UTM_campaign=marketplace_launch_apr2026, source=partner_marketplace. Also add GA4 event: marketplace_launch_click. Will share pixel snippet.

press-bot: Note: embargo exceptions require exec approval. Keep press release in drive under /press/drafts/marketplace_apr2026.md

legal-bot: Also confirm privacy checklist for demo data (no PII). If demo contains synthetic data only, mark as 'synthetic' in listing metadata.

anna (sales): Confirmed demo will use synthetic dataset. I'll update partner brief.

elaine (partnerships): Updated timeline recap:
- By 2026-04-06: send co-announcement draft to partner/legal
- By 2026-04-10 17:00 UTC: final press release + quotes in drive
- 2026-04-12: internal dry-run (marketing + eng + sales)
- 2026-04-14 09:00 UTC: embargo lifts / publish

Any blockers? If not I'll create a checklist card in Asana and assign owners. :white_check_mark:

tom (marketing): No blockers from marketing side. I'll link the draft and request a review from @jia and @sandeep by Tue.

jia (product): No blockers. Will review blog copy and landing page on Tue.

sandeep (eng): One note: please allow us a maintenance window on 2026-04-13 02:00-04:00 UTC for final integration flips. We'll post in #release-war-room.

elaine (partnerships): Great — I'll create tasks and tag owners. Thanks everyone.

(threads ends)
